info.title: PerfBot InfluxDB Functions
info.description: Functions for querying K6 performance metrics from InfluxDB

post.summary: Get the N most recent build IDs (testId) for a service
post.description: Returns the latest testId values for a given testName, sorted by time descending. Use this first to find which builds exist before querying metrics.

get_builds.summary: Get latest 2 build IDs for platform-objectdb-api
get_builds.value:
from(bucket: "k6")
  |> range(start: -30d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["testName"] == "platform-objectdb-api")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "http_req_duration")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "testId"])
  |> group(columns: ["testId"])
  |> last(column: "_time")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 2)
